content.short: Defx is an orderbook-based spot DEX, a perpetuals DEX, and an L1 platform.
content.description: Defx is a decentralized exchange and Layer 1 platform offering perpetual futures with up to 25x leverage in regular markets and 1000x in Degen mode. Built on Tendermint’s consensus and EVM-compatible, Defx delivers a centralized-exchange experience without counterparty risk or usability trade-offs. Contracts are available on Arbitrum, Solana, TON, Base, Ethereum, and other EVM-compatible chains. Features include liquidity vaults, multi-collateral support, and just-in-time funding.
